_comment: HYRAK-curated Hugging Face models for the model browser, grouped by use case. Every entry is checked at startup (app/models_custom/browse.validate_recommended): repo owner/name, file ends in .onnx, category one of the six listed there, task detect or classify, fps a number or null, verified_at YYYY-MM-DD or null (null = not yet run through the HYRAK check). license_note null means the server fills it for AGPL and cc-by-nc licences. PLACEHOLDER entries: replace with the verified list.

models.name: Everyday objects (DETR)
models.what: Finds 80 kinds of everyday things like people, cars, bikes and dogs.

models.name: Small object finder (YOLOS tiny)
models.what: A small, quick model that finds cars, trucks, buses and people on the road.

models.name: Picture namer (ViT)
models.what: Looks at the whole picture and says which of 1000 kinds of thing it shows.
